svg.title: Artifact transfer and multi-location custody identity
svg.desc: A Check-in Operation declares Artifact Transfers. Each transfer is authorized by one or more short-lived grants addressed to an eligible Vault Endpoint and produces authenticated receipts. Artifact Custody owns private staged candidates, verified logical Artifacts and one or more physical locations. Replication Tasks create or repair locations under an exact Storage Durability Policy version. Only a committed Controlled Product Data operation creates Generations whose manifests reference the logical Artifact.
